title: Safe apply + rollback PRD: drive stakeholder review, sign-off, and readiness to start build
creator: Paula Mendes
project: Safe apply + rollback mechanism (Cost Optimization Automation)
description:
Goal
Track completion of the PRD for “Safe apply + rollback mechanism” (Optimization Config versioning + staged rollout + one-click rollback) and ensure we have explicit stakeholder review/sign-off + resolved open questions before Engineering starts build.

Why this exists
We have repeated incidents/support escalations tied to optimization config changes (batching/caching/quant profiles) causing latency regressions or mis-scoped rollout. We need a PRD that is clear on:
- who can change what (RBAC)
- what gets recorded (audit)
- how changes roll out safely (gates)
- what “rollback” means operationally (semantics, idempotency, race conditions)
- how Hosted/Dedicated differs from Private

Definition of done (for this ticket)
1) PRD sections complete:
   - Problem statement + background (including incident/support drivers)
   - Goals / Non-goals
   - Personas + user stories (internal on-call operators; customer admins for Hosted/Dedicated; Private operators)
   - Requirements:
     - Versioned Optimization Config objects (immutable versions + metadata)
     - Safe apply workflow (validate → staged rollout → gates → promote)
     - Rollback workflow (one-click rollback in Console + API; idempotent applier; race-condition safeguards)
     - Audit logging requirements (event taxonomy, required fields, retention expectation, SIEM export compatibility)
     - RBAC model (roles/permissions; approval expectations; least privilege defaults)
     - Hosted/Dedicated vs Private behaviors
   - Success metrics: change-failure rate, rollback time-to-mitigate, % changes gated/blocked correctly, audit completeness
   - Rollout plan: internal beta → limited GA → broader GA, and feature flag strategy
   - GA readiness checklist (telemetry, dashboards, runbooks, support enablement)

2) Sign-off captured in PRD or in this ticket comments from:
   - Control plane Eng lead (Ethan Park)
   - Runtime architect (Noah Patel)
   - Console EM/architect (Chloe Martin/Jada Williams)
   - SRE lead (Sean Gallagher)
   - Security PM + Security sponsor (Naomi Feldman + Dr. Aisha Rahman)
   - Applied ML/Evals lead (Jonas Weber) for quant gating section

3) Open questions resolved or explicitly deferred with owners + dates.

Open questions to resolve before build (blocking)
A) Rollback semantics / correctness
- What is the exact “completion” definition for rollback in distributed workers?
  - Proposed: rollback API returns when control plane pointer is updated + rollout controller enqueued; Console shows ‘In progress’ until worker convergence threshold met.
  - Need explicit SLO for convergence (e.g., 95% workers within X minutes) + how we handle stragglers.
Owner: Ethan Park / Noah Patel. Due: 2025-10-22.

B) Scope and blast radius
- Canonical scoping model: tenant/model/region AND how it maps to Dedicated pools + Private clusters.
- How to represent partial rollouts (e.g., 10% canary) in “blast radius summary” and audit payload.
Owner: Jada Williams / Benji Okafor. Due: 2025-10-18.

C) Gate signals and default thresholds
- Default SLO gates: 5xx rate, p95/p99 latency, saturation (GPU util/queue depth), and pause/resume behavior.
- False positives: minimum sample windows and “cooldown” after deploy.
- Quantization quality gate: which eval suite, thresholds, and what constitutes pass/fail under noisy signals.
Owners: Sean Gallagher + Jonas Weber + Arjun Desai. Due: 2025-10-21.

D) RBAC + approvals
- Clarify “optimization change operator” role: does it include rollback? Is rollback allowed during Sev events for on-call only?
- Approval model: do we require 2-person review for high-blast changes (enterprise tenants / multi-region) or only policy guidance?
Owners: Naomi Feldman + Marcus Lin + Jordan Lee. Due: 2025-10-24.

E) Audit logging / compliance
- Required fields (request_id, actor, scope, config_version, previous_version, reason, change_summary/diff hash).
- Retention expectations by tier and how customers access exports.
- Confirm SIEM-export mapping and any PII constraints.
Owners: Kevin Osei + Dr. Aisha Rahman. Due: 2025-10-25.

F) Private deployment operator experience
- What is the supported operator path: helm values pin + ‘rollback’ command in installer? What is required for “one-click” in Private (if any)?
- Documented rollback with minimal downtime and how we surface active version.
Owners: Vivek Kulkarni + Kira Thompson. Due: 2025-10-28.

Non-blocking follow-ups (can be deferred if explicitly called out)
- Customer-visible change history formatting (field-level visibility + retention in Console)
- Webhook/event stream requirements for config changes
- Fully automated rollback (without human confirmation) beyond selected internal accounts

Risks noted in PRD review
- Race conditions: concurrent apply + rollback leading to mixed worker state (must be addressed by runtime idempotency + controller serialization)
- Overly aggressive gates causing rollouts to stall and create operational load
- Under-specified Private path leading to inconsistent customer experience and support escalations

Acceptance criteria for “ready to build”
- Owners agree on rollback semantics + convergence SLO
- Gate thresholds and pause/rollback policy documented with sane defaults
- RBAC permission list reviewed by Security (including rollback visibility in Console)
- Audit event taxonomy approved with examples
- Console UX edge cases documented: partial rollout, rollback to pre-canary version, and rollback cooldown

References / related work

- Engineering epic issues: ENG-4821..ENG-4830
- Design tickets: DES-211..DES-213
